messages:
sara (Design): Hey team, planning a 30-day family trial in Phoenix from 2024-11-01 to 2024-11-30. Do I need to declare? worried about WFH stipend, payroll withholding, and temporarily shipping my laptop. :house_with_garden:
ida (People Ops): Hi Sara — yes, please submit the temporary homebase form for any stay >30 days OR if you'll be working from a different state for payroll purposes. For exactly 30 days it's optional but we prefer you declare so payroll/tax vendor can log it. Form: https://hr.redwood.example/homebase-declare
sara (Design): Good to know. If I declare, will my monthly WFH allowance be prorated for November?
omar (Finance): Stipend is prorated by calendar days. If your standard is $200/month and you're remote in AZ for 30 days out of 30 in Nov, you'll get full amount. If dates span months we'll split by actual days in each month. We calculate on the payroll run and confirm in the paystub.
sara (Design): OK thanks. Do I need to change tax withholdings or will payroll auto-adjust for AZ? Arizona has income tax — I live in CA normally.
omar (Finance): Good Q. Short stays often don't change withholding but dual-state exposure can be triggered. Because CA is your resident state, CA withholding likely stays. Payroll will flag potential nonresident AZ withholding if our tax vendor thinks a filing is necessary. Expect a review within 3 business days after form submission.
sara (Design): Understood. About the laptop 10 I need to ship it to my in-laws' place in Phoenix for those weeks. Is shipping covered? any customs or insurance paperwork?
ida (People Ops): Domestic shipping covered up to $75 for temporary moves. Please open an equipment ticket and mention "temporary shipping" + attach the homebase-declare confirmation. If shipping value >$75, manager pre-approval required.
sara (Design): I created ticket #EQ-7120. Requested shipping Nov 1 delivery.
equip-bot: EQ-7120 logged. Please attach recipient name, phone, and delivery address. Standard insured shipping option selected.
sara (Design): Attached now. Does IT need any special notes for VPN or location-based MFA?
ida (People Ops): IT usually sees no issue for domestic moves, but mention it in the ticket if you anticipate using public wifi a lot. Also, if you're switching to a different ISP for >90 days we ask IT to re-evaluate access tokens.
nina (Manager): Nina here, I reviewed Sara's plan and ack the temporary move. No objections. @ida please mark manager ack on the form.
ida (People Ops): Thanks Nina 97 will note manager ack. Sara, quick note on benefits: health/401k unaffected for a 30-day move. Worker comp stays linked to your permanent homebase. If you end up staying >182 days we escalate coverage changes.
sara (Design): Awesome. One last thing: do I need to update my emergency contact/address in ADP or will People Ops sync that?
omar (Finance): Update personal address in ADP and People Ops will reconcile for payroll. If you fail to update, tax vendor may send a notice.
hr-bot: "homebase-declare" form saved for sara at 1746002468. Next steps: People Ops review -> Payroll/TAX review (3 business days) -> Equip ticket EQ-7120 approved pending docs.
ida (People Ops): All set on our end. Omar will post when payroll completes the review. Have a great trip! :sun_with_face:
